definitions.explanation: To cause something to make a noise.

examples.japanese: クラクション⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鳴|な}らす。
⟦{目覚|めざ}まし{時計|どけい}→目覚まし時計：03159_mezamashidokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鳴|な}らしても、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{起|お}きられない→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Even when I set the alarm clock, I can't easily wake up.

notes:
{鳴|な}らす means to cause something to produce sound — to ring, sound, or play.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {鳴|な}る (intransitive — the thing itself sounds)

ASPECT (ている):
{鳴|な}らしている means 'is ringing/sounding (something)' — an ongoing action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ベルを{鳴|な}らす: to ring a bell
- {警報|けいほう}を{鳴|な}らす: to sound an alarm
- クラクションを{鳴|な}らす: to honk a horn
- {指|ゆび}を{鳴|な}らす: to snap one's fingers
- {太鼓|たいこ}を{鳴|な}らす: to beat a drum

IDIOM:
{名|な}を{鳴|な}らす means to make a name for oneself, to become famous.
